thread:
Ivy: Kicking off staged rollout v4.0.0 -> 12% on /generate. Change window 2026-05-05 02:00 UTC. Deploybot will post manifest.

deploy-bot: Rollout started: release=v4.0.0 rollout=staged traffic=12% route=/generate id=r-1769990012
```
deployctl start --release v4.0.0 --staged 12 --route /generate
apply -f rollouts/r-1769990012.yaml
```

Marcus: Obs ask: watch p95, 5xx, tokenization_err, and kv-cache hitrate. Dash: https://dash.redwood/rollouts/r-1769990012

Jun: Pinned route binding to model v4.0.0 and set runtime flag prefetch_kv=true for canary. Release notes linked in PR.

deploy-bot: Canary applied. Running 15m smoke window. Will surface signals.

monitor-bot: SIGNAL r-1769990012: p95 +18ms (5m), 5xx=0.08%, kv-cache miss +3%. tokenization_err 0.02%. No allocation errors.

Marcus: All small. Continue. Keep eyes on kv-cache miss trend.

monitor-bot: ALERT r-1769990012: kv-cache miss rate = 14% (3m). Top log: "kvcache: eviction pressure" on infra-d-03. Link: https://logs.redwood/rollouts/r-1769990012

Jun: Hmm. prefetch_kv might be thrashing with new model memory layout. Recommend reduce canary to 5% and run another 10m probe, unless SRE wants immediate stop.

Ivy: Proposed action: scale down traffic to 5% and extend probe. If miss rate stays >12% for 5m OR any "malloc failed" -> stop. Approve?

Marcus: Approve the shrink+probe. Manual stop ready if we see regressions.

deploy-bot: Updating rollout: set traffic=5% id=r-1769990012
```
deployctl update --id r-1769990012 --traffic 5
```

monitor-bot: SIGNAL r-1769990012: kv-cache miss = 21% (4m). Top log: "malloc failed: cannot allocate memory" on infra-d-03-7.

SRE-bot: That's a hard stop. Manual STOP requested. Rollback plan: route -> v3.9.8, annotate image quarantined, scale canary down, collect heap+kv dumps.

Jun: Manual STOP from SRE. Please execute rollback and preserve artifacts for triage.

deploy-bot: STOP acknowledged by @SRE-bot. Executing rollback steps:
```
route set /generate --version=3.9.8
scale deployment llm-gen-v4.0.0 --replicas=0
kubectl annotate pod --selector=rollout=r-1769990012 quarantined=true
collect-artifacts --id r-1769990012 --artifacts=heap-dump,kvcache-dump,tokenizer-dump
```

Ivy: Confirm rollback. Opening tracker R-7142 for memory regression investigation and rollout policy review. Adding owners: @Jun, @Marcus, @SRE-bot.

Jun: I'll attach allocator trace and kv eviction metrics before the 03:30 triage.

Marcus: Updating release notes: "Canary v4.0.0 rolled back to v3.9.8 due to kv-cache memory regression and allocation failures. Image quarantined." Tags: rollback, memory, kvcache.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Route now -> 3.9.8. Canary scaled down. State=ROLLED_BACK.
